messages:
Elaine - Marketing: Quick sync — finalizing the release lane for tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Need three quick things from eng/docs/events before I lock the announce: 1) final changelog URL (stable) 2) docs link that we can point the blog to (no redirects) 3) confirmed webinar/demo slot and embargo lift time. Can people drop links and a one-line blocker status?

Matt - Eng: changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/2026-03-24-release. It's the final draft, I pushed the last patch for the param routing note. No blockers from infra side but we have a 30-min canary window after deploy.

Sarah - Docs: docs: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/release/2026-03-24 — stable. I'm holding off on the small how-to snippet until I get the final sample code from Matt, but nothing blocking publication. ETA for docs push: 1.5 hrs from now if Matt confirms code snippet.

Matt - Eng: putting snippet here, use this in the docs and blog code example (small):
```
// client pin to model variant
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/fast-13b-v2',
  prompt: 'Summarize the Q3 roadmap',
  max_tokens: 200
});
console.log(res.text);
```
This is the exact API we validated in canary. No changes expected.

Zoe - Growth: Webinar slot confirmed for 11:00 PT (starts 11:05 to allow join flow). We'll run a 20-min demo + 15-min Q&A. Can we set embargo lift to 11:00 PT as well so press can start posting when the webinar opens? Also, is there a canonical UTM we should use for webinar signups? Suggest: utm_campaign=release_2026_03_24.

Elaine - Marketing: Ok — aiming embargo lift 11:00 PT. Matt, can you confirm the canary completes before 11:00 if we start deploy at 09:00 PT? If not we may need to push the webinar to 11:30.

Matt - Eng: Canary schedule: deploy @ 09:00 PT -> 09:00-09:30 canary -> 09:30-10:00 progressive rollout -> 10:00 all traffic. We meet the 11:00 embargo. If any regressions during canary we'll fallback to previous tag; rollback path tested.

Sarah - Docs: I'll bake the example from Matt into the code block and ship docs by 10:10 PT, leaving a 50-min buffer for last-minute copy tweak.

Zoe - Growth: Inbound routing: please add the lead tag release=mar24 and priority=high for webinar attendees. Ops will pickup via Airtable webhook. Elaine: do we need a separate demo sign-up page?

Elaine - Marketing: We'll use the blog CTA -> registration modal. Zoe, I want a short landing copy saved in this thread. Draft: "See Redwood Inference in action — live demo of latency/cost optimizations + Q&A. Register to join." Can you shorten?

Zoe - Growth: Nice. Short version: "Live demo: fast, cost-effective LLM inference. Register now." I'll post the final modal copy in #growth in 20m.

Matt - Eng: FYI ops: if we detect increased tail latency in canary > 2x baseline, auto-fall back and alert #eng-oncall. Config snippet for rollout policy: 
```
rollout:
  canary: 30m
  progressive: 50% -> 100%
  health_check: latency_tail_p95_threshold: 2x
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created by Matt at 1792233400. Canaries/rollout configured. CI artifacts: artifact-redwood-inference-2026-03-24.tar.gz

Elaine - Marketing: Excellent. Final checklist for announce: changelog link (done), docs link (done), webinar slot (done), embargo set to 11:00 PT (confirmed). Next: who will post the release blog? I'll draft and ask for a +1 before publishing.

Sarah - Docs: +1 to review the blog for doc accuracy once Elaine posts draft.

Matt - Eng: +1 for us on infra notes. I'll be on standby 08:30-11:30 PT for any rollback.

Zoe - Growth: I'll coordinate the webinar invite and landing modal. Will attach final guest list and tracking UTMs by EOD. :thumbsup:

Elaine - Marketing: Thanks team. If anything changes, ping me here with uplifts. If we stay green, publish flow: blog + changelog at 11:00 PT, webinar 11:05 PT, social posts queued for 11:10 PT.

Matt - Eng: noted. I'll post to this thread if canary shows any issues.

Elaine - Marketing: Great — locking plan. :party_parrot:
